integrity: The result gives a mathematical proof and openly stated source dependencies; verification is same-model reviewed, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only parameters p prime, a >= 1, 1 <= \(\(m<p\)\), m*\(p^a\) >= 3 are proved. Exact full-gcd values for arbitrary larger cofactors are not covered. The proof uses a published local prime-support criterion. Finite verification is not an infinite proof. An older general-title paper was not available in full and may contain an overlooked equivalent theorem.
title: Exact binomial greatest common divisors on one-digit prime-power cofactors
